parameters.description:
`msg-to-ryver` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Ryver destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Ryver destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Ryver destinations bound per enrollment.

In Ryver, make sure the forum you want to notify already exists, then go to Integrations → Incoming Webhooks in your settings and click Create Webhook. Choose either Slack or Plain/text Ryver as the webhook type, set it to Chat Message, and select the forum(s) it should be allowed to post to. Ryver then gives you a URL such as https://yourorg.ryver.com/application/webhook/<TOKEN> — copy just the token segment at the end into RYVER_TOKEN.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Ryver destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Ryver incoming webhook
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Ryver destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.
